name: Power Price Collector
short_desc: European day-ahead power prices into QuestDB, MQTT, Grist and more
author: EckPhi
description: Collects EPEX SPOT day-ahead power prices via the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform and writes them to configurable sinks: QuestDB, generic InfluxDB line protocol, Telegraf, MQTT (with optional Home Assistant discovery) and Grist. Ships a web UI for configuration, component health and the current price curve. Covers 40 European bidding zones, handles 15/30/60-minute market time units, and keeps negative prices intact.

form_fields.label: ENTSO-E API token
form_fields.hint: Free. Register at transparency.entsoe.eu, then email transparency@entsoe.eu from that address with subject 'Restful API access'. Reference it in the config as ${ENTSOE_API_TOKEN}.

form_fields.label: QuestDB host
form_fields.hint: Host LAN IP of the QuestDB app, e.g. 192.168.1.10 — apps sit on separate compose networks, so the service name 'questdb' will not resolve. Reference it as ${QUESTDB_HOST}.

form_fields.label: MQTT host
form_fields.hint: Broker host LAN IP. Reference it as ${MQTT_HOST}.

form_fields.label: InfluxDB token
form_fields.hint: Only for the generic ILP sink pointed at InfluxDB 2.x.
